content:
At Praanavaidya Hospital, our dedicated team of highly qualified physicians forms the foundation of our pledge to deliver outstanding healthcare services. With a wealth of knowledge across diverse fields in both Ayurveda and contemporary medicine, our doctors provide tailored, comprehensive care to each patient. This blog serves to introduce you to the esteemed medical experts at Praanavaidya Hospital, showcasing their areas of specialization and the measures they take to guarantee optimal patient outcomes.

Dr. Pramod Karanth: Expert in Holistic Ayurvedic Treatments | Qualifications: BAMS, MD (Ayu) | Experience: 4 years

Dr. Pramod Karanth is a distinguished Ayurvedic practitioner dedicated to the holistic treatment of chronic ailments. His specialization involves the development of individualized treatment strategies that take into account the distinct constitution and health requirements of each patient. Whether addressing chronic diseases, enhancing immune function, or implementing detoxification protocols, Dr. Pramod’s methodology guarantees that every individual receives customized care aimed at fostering enduring health.

At Praanavaidya Hospital, Dr. Pramod integrates the time-honoured principles of Ayurveda with contemporary medical knowledge, enabling him to effectively manage conditions such as gastrointestinal disorders, respiratory challenges, and musculoskeletal issues. His compassionate demeanour and unwavering commitment to patient care establish him as a reliable practitioner for those in pursuit of holistic healing solutions.

 

Dr. Swasthika: Specialist in Comprehensive Ayurvedic Care | Qualifications: BAMS, MD (Ayu) | Experience: 5 years

Dr. Swasthika is a dedicated Ayurvedic physician with a strong commitment to addressing a diverse array of health issues through her profound knowledge of Ayurvedic practices. Her specialization in Panchakarma and various detoxification methods positions her as a vital member of the Praanavaidya team. Dr. Swasthika prioritizes patient education and empowerment, ensuring that each patient comprehends their treatment strategy and actively participates in their recovery process.

Individuals dealing with ailments such as skin conditions, metabolic disorders, and diseases related to lifestyle find comfort in Dr. Swasthika’s care. Her focus on patient-centered care, along with her expertise in Ayurvedic treatments, enables patients to attain enduring health and equilibrium in their lives.

 

Dr. Pradeep S J: Experienced Family Physician with a Holistic Approach | Qualifications: MBBS, Consultant Family Physician | Experience: 9 years

Dr. Pradeep S J possesses nearly ten years of experience as a family physician, integrating contemporary medical practices with holistic methodologies to deliver comprehensive healthcare. His vast expertise in addressing a diverse range of medical issues enables him to provide well-rounded health solutions for individuals across all age groups. Dr. Pradeep excels in preventive medicine, ensuring that patients not only receive care for their current ailments but also acquire knowledge on sustaining optimal health through lifestyle modifications and preventive measures.

At Praanavaidya Hospital, Dr. Pradeep’s responsibilities as a family physician encompass the management of both acute and chronic conditions, the provision of preventive care, and the offering of advice on healthy living. His capacity to engage with patients and comprehend their distinct health challenges positions him as a pivotal contributor to the delivery of holistic healthcare solutions.

 

Dr. Chetan Upadhyaya: Ayurvedic Surgeon with a Focus on Comprehensive Care | Qualifications: MS (Ayu), FAGE | Experience: 6 years

Dr. Chetan Upadhyaya is an accomplished Ayurvedic surgeon, adept in both surgical and non-surgical methodologies. His distinctive ability to merge traditional Ayurvedic surgical techniques with contemporary practices enables him to deliver comprehensive care for conditions necessitating surgical intervention. Dr. Chetan emphasizes minimally invasive procedures and possesses a profound knowledge of post-operative care, ensuring that patients undergo a seamless recovery and achieve enduring results.

At Praanavaidya Hospital, Dr. Chetan plays a crucial role in handling cases that demand surgical accuracy, including hernias, piles, and fissures, while also offering holistic care that targets the underlying causes of these conditions. His patient-centered philosophy and dedication to holistic healing establish him as a reliable surgeon for individuals exploring Ayurvedic treatment alternatives.

 

Dr. Pradeep Kumar N: Expert Surgeon with a Patient-Centric Approach | Qualifications: MBBS, DNB (Gen Surgery), DNB (Plastic Surgery), MBA | Experience: 9 years

Dr. Pradeep Kumar N is an exceptionally qualified surgeon, possessing dual expertise in both general and plastic surgery. His vast experience, coupled with advanced surgical techniques, positions him as a specialist in executing intricate procedures with accuracy and diligence. Dr. Pradeep adopts a patient-centered philosophy in his surgical practice, ensuring that each operation is customized to meet the unique requirements of the patient, with a strong focus on achieving optimal results.

At Praanavaidya Hospital, Dr. Pradeep is recognized for his proficiency in conducting reconstructive surgeries, managing trauma cases, and performing cosmetic interventions. His ability to merge surgical skill with a compassionate demeanor guarantees that patients receive exemplary care throughout the entire surgical process, from pre-operative assessments to post-operative recovery. Whether addressing critical surgical needs or enhancing aesthetic appearance, Dr. Pradeep’s thorough attention to detail and commitment to patient welfare establish him as an integral member of the surgical team.

Dr. Sandhya Lakshmi: Specialist in Ayurvedic Endocrinology and Women’s Health | Qualifications: BAMS, MD (Ayu), YIC (Ayurvedic Endocrinology & Women’s Health) | Experience: 6 years

Dr. Sandhya Lakshmi is a distinguished Ayurvedic practitioner specializing in endocrinology and women’s health. Her proficiency in addressing hormonal imbalances, thyroid conditions, and reproductive health challenges positions her as an essential asset to the Praanavaidya team. Dr. Sandhya employs a holistic methodology, integrating dietary modifications, lifestyle adjustments, and Ayurvedic treatments to tackle the underlying causes of endocrine disorders and foster overall wellness.

At Praanavaidya Hospital, Dr. Sandhya is committed to empowering women through tailored healthcare strategies that meet their individual requirements. Her therapeutic approaches aim not only to relieve symptoms but also to improve the quality of life for women facing issues such as PCOS, menopause, and infertility. Her empathetic care and profound knowledge of women’s health render her a reliable consultant for patients in search of holistic remedies.

Dr. Sharadhi Hebbar: Advocate for Authentic Ayurvedic Treatments | Qualifications: BAMS | Experience: 3 years

Dr. Sharadhi Hebbar is a dedicated Ayurvedic practitioner who specializes in delivering authentic Ayurvedic therapies. Her commitment to the foundational principles of Ayurveda guarantees that patients receive treatments that are both natural and effective, devoid of adverse side effects. Dr. Sharadhi possesses significant expertise in addressing a variety of health issues, including digestive disorders, skin conditions, and stress-related problems.

At Praanavaidya Hospital, Dr. Sharadhi employs a comprehensive evaluation of the patient’s dosha (body constitution) and incorporates natural therapies such as herbal remedies, Panchakarma, and dietary modifications. Her patient-centered philosophy and adherence to the essential values of Ayurveda establish her as a reliable healer for individuals seeking natural and holistic care.

Dr. Vaishnavi Kini: Integrating Tradition and Modernity in Ayurvedic Care | Qualifications: BAMS, MD (Ayu) | Experience: 4 years

Dr. Vaishnavi Kini is a distinguished Ayurvedic physician renowned for her ability to merge traditional Ayurvedic methodologies with contemporary medical knowledge. Her healthcare philosophy is all-encompassing, effectively addressing both acute and chronic ailments through a combination of natural remedies and scientifically supported practices. Dr. Vaishnavi possesses particular expertise in managing conditions such as arthritis, respiratory issues, and lifestyle-related diseases.

At Praanavaidya Hospital, Dr. Vaishnavi is responsible for developing personalized treatment strategies that take into account the patient’s overall well-being, lifestyle choices, and unique medical requirements. Her commitment to ongoing education and her capacity to modify Ayurvedic treatments to meet modern health challenges render her an essential member of the medical team. Patients receiving her care benefit from a holistic methodology that not only alleviates symptoms but also fosters long-term health and wellness.

Why Choose Praanavaidya Hospital?

Praanavaidya Hospital distinguishes itself through its dedication to comprehensive and individualized healthcare. Our team of physicians is not only exceptionally qualified but also passionately committed to integrating the principles of Ayurveda with contemporary medical practices. By selecting Praanavaidya, patients can expect:  

  • Comprehensive Care: Our physicians provide an extensive array of treatments, encompassing chronic disease management, preventive care, and surgical procedures.
  • Personalized Treatment Plans: Each patient is provided with a tailored treatment plan that addresses their specific health requirements and aspirations.  
  • Holistic Approach: We merge the rich traditions of Ayurvedic knowledge with modern medical methodologies to deliver well-rounded healthcare.  
  • Expertise Across Specializations: Whether you require surgical intervention, management of chronic conditions, or wellness therapies, our varied team of specialists guarantees the highest standard of care.  

At Praanavaidya Hospital, we are devoted to assisting you in attaining optimal health through the collective expertise of our proficient doctors. Whether you are pursuing treatment for a particular ailment or aiming to enhance your overall wellness, our team is dedicated to supporting you throughout your health journey.

Conclusion

The medical professionals at Praanavaidya Hospital serve not merely as healthcare providers; they act as collaborators in your pursuit of improved health. With their vast experience, specialized expertise, and empathetic approach, they are fully prepared to tackle any health issue you may encounter. By selecting Praanavaidya, you are opting for a healthcare institution that places your well-being at the forefront, delivering treatments that are both effective and holistic.

Whether you are dealing with a chronic illness, in need of preventive care, or seeking a natural path to wellness, our team of specialists is dedicated to supporting you throughout your journey. Rely on the proficiency of Praanavaidya’s physicians, and embark on the first step toward a healthier and more fulfilling life.
